findings.detail: The 2029 iHeartCommunications corporate bond has a 9.13% source coupon, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.
The 2030 iHeartCommunications corporate bond has a 10.88% source coupon, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.

rationale: C01 flagged rate coverage because only 5 of 7 debt rows have extracted rates. The two missing-rate debt rows are the March 31, 2026 iHeartCommunications corporate bonds, and the raw SOI table gives explicit interest-rate cells of 9.13% and 10.88% for those rows. Because source rates exist but the extracted interest_rate fields are blank, the flag is a real extraction gap.
